messages:
jen: Spinning up eu-north-1 GPU cluster tomorrow morning. Need quick security baseline + smoke checks for IAM, Secrets, KMS/HSM before handoff. cc @sam @irina

sam: Thanks — can you paste the bare-min IAM roles/policies we should create? Also any notes on node vs runtime permissions?

jen: High-level checklist (short):
- Node InstanceProfile: ssm:*, ec2:Describe*, kms:Decrypt limited to node bootstrap key
- Serving runtime role: sts:AssumeRole from node, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, kms:Decrypt (model keys)
- Provisioning/admin role: kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Encrypt, iam:CreateRole (restricted)
- Audit/ReadOnly role: logs:*, cloudtrail:LookupEvents (for audits)
- KMS: dedicate a customer-managed key (HSM-backed) for customer secrets; separate key for platform signing

snippets: KMS key policy (example):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowAdmins",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-kms-admins"},
      "Action": ["kms:*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AllowClusterDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-serving-runtime-eun1"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:cluster": "eu-north-1-{{cluster-id}}"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

irina: Add a strict condition on encryption context to prevent key reuse across clusters. Also enforce key rotation (90 days) and CMK admins separate from runtime users.

sam: For secrets: store model credentials & signing keys in Secrets Manager with a resource policy like: 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-serving-runtime-eun1"},
    "Action": ["secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"],
    "Resource": "*",
    "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"secretsmanager:ResourceTag/cluster": "eu-north-1-{{cluster-id}}"}}
  }]
}
```

omar: Quick cost/quota notes: open GPU quota increase ticket with the cloud now — provisioning might be blocked otherwise. HSM-backed keys incur extra monthly cost (estimate ~$200-400/month per key). Consider using single HSM key for platform signing + CMK for customer data if acceptable. Also consider reserved GPU capacity vs burst for steady workloads.

security-bot: sec-scan: baseline policy-lint v0.9 run on proposed IAM/KMS configs. Result: PASS with 2 WARNINGS — (1) missing automatic key rotation tag, (2) IAM trust policy allows wide sts:AssumeRole for svc accounts (recommend restricting by source ARN).

jen: I'll update rotation schedule and tighten trust policy. Sample trust restriction for provisioning role: 
```json
"Condition": {"ArnEquals": {"aws:SourceArn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-provisioner"}}
```

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: eu-north-1 cluster bootstrapping scheduled 2026-03-19T09:30:00Z. Canary traffic: 10%. Fallback region: us-east-1.

irina: Handoff plan: I'll create the runbook entry under eng-infra/runbooks and open tickets: (1) quota increase, (2) CMK creation with HSM request, (3) secrets resource policy + rotation schedule. Tagging @oncall-eng-infra for verification after smoke.

sam: LGTM. I'll own the IAM policy PR and attach the policy tests. :thumbsup:

jen: Thanks — will post the final PR links here once ready.
